html:
This private fishing tour is suitable for guests who enjoy sport fishing or would like to experience big fish fishing in Phu Quoc. Guests can choose between a morning sunrise fishing trip or an afternoon fishing trip with sunset views.

Swimming is available during the tour. Any fish caught will be freshly prepared and cooked on board by the crew.

ITINERARY

Morning Fishing Trip (05:00 – 13:30)

05:15 – 05:30

Pick up at the hotel in Duong Dong Ward.

Guests staying outside Duong Dong Ward are requested to contact Vietlook Travel in advance.

Transfer to An Thoi Harbor and board the private fishing boat.

Enjoy sunrise at sea. Breakfast and Vietnamese coffee are served on board.

Fishing activities begin. Guests drop their fishing lines and wait for their catches.

Live fresh-cut squid or normal squid bait is used to catch large fish.

Swimming is available when sea conditions allow.

Lunch is served on board. Fish caught during the trip will be prepared and cooked by the crew.

13:30
Return to An Thoi Harbor and transfer back to the hotel.

Afternoon Fishing Trip (13:30 – 18:30)

13:15 – 13:30

Pick up at the hotel in Duong Dong Ward.

Guests staying outside Duong Dong Ward are requested to contact Vietlook Travel in advance.

Transfer to An Thoi Harbor and board the private fishing boat.

Late lunch is served on board before fishing activities begin.

Fishing activities take place in the late afternoon, one of the best times for fishing.

Swimming is available when sea conditions allow.

A light snack is served while enjoying the sunset at sea.

18:30
Return to An Thoi Harbor and transfer back to the hotel.

TOUR INCLUDES

  • Private air-conditioned car and private boat.

  • English-speaking tour guide.

  • Mineral water.

  • Meals on board according to the selected tour option.

  • Fishing equipment.

  • Snorkeling equipment including mask, snorkel, and fins.

  • Life jackets.

  • Ten live squid bait per guest.

TOUR EXCLUDES

  • Personal expenses.

  • Additional live squid bait beyond the included amount.

BREAKFAST

  • Bread.

  • Omelette.

  • Coffee.

  • Lipton tea.

  • Fresh milk.

  • Fresh fruit.

LUNCH

  • Shrimp and pork cooked in a clay pot.

  • Fried chicken.

  • Fried eggs.

  • Stir-fried morning glory with garlic.

  • Salad.

  • Vegetable soup with minced pork.

  • Steamed rice.

  • Fresh fruit.

Special meal requests such as vegan, vegetarian, or children’s meals must be informed at the time of booking or at least twenty-four hours before departure.

CHILDREN’S PRICING POLICY

Children under five years old:
Free of charge.

Children from five to nine years old:
Charged at fifty percent of the adult price.

Children aged ten years and above:
Charged at the adult price.

PAYMENT POLICY

Groups of one to five guests

Full payment must be completed no later than one day before the tour date.
Otherwise, the booking will be automatically cancelled.

Groups of six guests or more

Full payment must be completed no later than two days before the tour date.
Otherwise, the booking will be automatically cancelled.

CANCELLATION POLICY

Groups of one to five guests

Cancellation one day before the tour date:
No cancellation fee will be charged.

Cancellation on the tour date:
One hundred percent of the total tour value will be charged as a cancellation fee.

Groups of six guests or more

Cancellation two days before the tour date:
No cancellation fee will be charged.

Cancellation one day before the tour date:
Fifty percent of the total tour value will be charged as a cancellation fee.

Cancellation on the tour date:
One hundred percent of the total tour value will be charged as a cancellation fee.

HEALTH AND SAFETY

This tour is not recommended for guests with limited mobility or serious medical conditions.
Pregnant women and elderly guests should consult a doctor before joining the tour.

Vietlook Travel is not responsible for any health-related issues during or after the tour.
